en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a neoclassical complex with a central temple‑like building featuring a columned façade and triangular pediment, flanked by colonnaded wings. Two tall columns with statues stand in front, and there is a formal garden with palm trees and paths in the foreground. Greek and French captions are printed at the bottom, and there is handwriting and postal ink on the image.
